 Shyam Sundar Verma
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Shivraj Kushwaha - Advocate for the petitioner.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri V.S. Choudhary - G.A. for the State.

Order 
The petitioner is complainant of FIR at Crime No.795/2014 registered at Police Station Kulgawan,
District Satna under Section 420 of I.P.C.
It is the case of the petitioner that the police carried out investigation and submitted expunge report by way of final report under Section 173 Cr.P.C., which is placed on record as Annexure P-5.
The said report under 173 Cr.P.C. was submitted in the year 2015.

The petitioner submitted objections to the said expunge report and on consideration of objection of the petitioner the concerned Magistrate rejected the expunge report by order dated 31.07.2023 and returned the case diary back to the police.

Now, the petitioner is aggrieved by inaction of the police in filing a fresh final report before the concerned Court and it is stated by the petitioner that after the expunge report was rejected by the concerned Magistrate, the police has not carried out any further investigation or any other further proceedings in the matter and the FIR continues to remain pending before NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55683 2 WP-32961-2024 police.

Considering the aforesaid contention and documents placed on record, the respondent No.3 is directed to conclude the proceedings pending before him in relation to FIR at Crime No.795/2014 within a period of one month from the date of production of copy of this order and file appropriate report before the concerned Magistrate in accordance with law.
